notes: All five advisories are repo-owned GHSAs -> vendor_official review status, T1.
Every fix commit is behind_by 0 of the release that shipped it: 87cc78a25f78 -> 3.0.6, 9bdec46fe495 -> 3.1.4, 37797aba2600 -> 3.1.5, f54fe9802625 -> 3.1.6, b2a2c0973008 -> 3.1.9.

Only 87cc78a25f78 applies to the 3.0.2 tree with git apply --check; the three device-name follow-ups assume code added in 3.1.4-3.1.6 that does not exist at 3.0.2, so their vulnerable state is established by verbatim line checks and the absence of any device-name filtering.
CVE-2024-49766 is platform-conditional (Windows, Python < 3.11); its advisory range is <= 3.0.5 and the frozen 3.0.2 is inside it.
